markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (77%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second model and 4 of 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 77%, Invasive 23% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Concept model links it to invasive; single region · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits in situ pattern · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 6, 8) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Highest concept score here; failed spot check, 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; failed spot check, 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Invasive risk is 23%; similar case BACH_0205 is labeled Invasive.
- Image is JPEG-degraded (severity 3); reliability error AUROC is only 0.69 (CI 0.58–0.87).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6**: look for tumor breaking out of ducts into stroma; four concept scores peak here.
2. **Regions 9, 10, 2**: largest heatmap contribution toward invasive; look for invasive nests.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 8**: mitosis score failed its spot check; count mitoses directly.
